prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Finish new screen changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests, with 1 test stopped early due to worse adoption.
Adoption new screen changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for choose path redesign, finish new flow, finish redesign, home redesign, sign-in hint, and sign-in redesign changes.
Positive predictions were generally too high, though round 11 was underpredicted.
Negative predictions were too low, as all tests predicting negative results measured positive outcomes after noise correction.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -2.5% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +11.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: -2.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: +1.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, redesign: +1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 87.2%, median 8s / mean 514s

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Path Selection Split Overview: Redesign the path selection screen into a side-by-side split view highlighting standard adoption versus custom pet creation options. (why: Choose path mean completion time is extremely high at 514s, indicating decision hesitation between creation paths.)
1: [choose_path, hint] Path Choice Guidance Hint: Add a clear guidance hint reassuring users that pet options can be customized further after completing setup. (why: High mean time (514s) on path selection suggests users worry about locking themselves into permanent choices.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync Persistence Hint: Add an account persistence hint explaining that signing in safeguards pets across app restarts. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
3: [adoption, new_screen] Adoption Summary New Screen: Insert a new review screen before certification summarizing the chosen pet's attributes and appearance. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% with 1017s mean time, showing users need confirmation before completing adoption.)
4: [adoption, layout] Pet Selection Card Layout: Change the pet selection step layout to a structured card grid with clear breed visual badges. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9%.)
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Ready Notification Toggle: Enable time estimates and background arrival notifications on the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s (median 201s), causing high drop-off during background pet generation.)
6: [home, new_flow] Interactive Wait Activity Flow: Add an interactive teaser sub-flow screen featuring pet tip carousels while pet generation runs. (why: Home step waiting time is long (median 201s, mean 2336s), causing drop-off during background generation.)
7: [finish, redesign] Desktop Controls Checklist Redesign: Redesign the home intro screen into an interactive checklist detailing desktop pet interactions. (why: 3 support tickets highlighted post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
8: [finish, notification] Desktop Companion Activation Notification: Add an explicit status hint and system notification trigger on the final screen explaining system tray controls. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets not appearing on screen or users unable to re-open the desktop app.)
